intro.what: Godzilla close-up at night: his dorsal plates and mouth light up blue as he charges his ray (one shot)

loop.what: New York at night: Rodan swoops past the Empire State Building and a full moon, glass shatters, ends on Rodan silhouetted against the moon

loop2.what: Dark blue ruined Tokyo: Godzilla faces Monster X, then a wide shot of the two fighting among burning ruins

loop3.what: Keizer Ghidorah towers over the dark smoking city, then its heads attack Godzilla

phase.what: Godzilla's ray erupts across the night city in a blue-white blast

won.what: Godzilla glows blue and fires his red spiral ray, a blazing column across the screen

lost.what: Keizer Ghidorah's golden gravity beams pour into Godzilla, draining him

music.what: the end-title score (bed finder: final 0.895, the best of the eight films)

phase1.what: Godzilla roaring through the smoke in the city (the game's own 1954 roar matches 0.77; a harmonic roar)

won.what: Godzilla's roar after the battle (harmonic roar cpp 0.43, the strongest)

lost.what: Keizer Ghidorah's gravity beams striking (broadband onset at 1:51:39.0)

phase2.what: Keizer Ghidorah's three heads rising and roaring as Monster X becomes it
